overview: An unattractive 7th grader struggles to cope with suburban life as the middle child with un-attentive parents and bullies at school.
tagline: Not all girls want to play with dolls.

recs.blurb: A young man's peculiar upbringing renders him unable to competently cope with the struggle of growing up.
In 1976, a lower-middle-class teenager struggles to cope living with her neurotic family of nomads on the outskirts of Beverly Hills.
Three middle-aged wealthy couples take vacations together in Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter. Along the way we are treated to mid-life, marital, parental and…
As he copes with the death of his fiancee along with her parents, a young man must figure out what he wants out of life.
A group of high school seniors meets in the summer of 1965 and all struggle with the choices they have to make.
Aidan Bloom, a struggling actor, father and husband, is 35 years old and still trying to find a purpose for his life. He and his wife are barely getting by…
A day in the life of two film-school students trying to find love and another house-mate.
An original mix of fiction and reality illuminates the life of comic book hero everyman Harvey Pekar.
The picaresque and touching story of the politically incorrect, fully lived life of the impulsive, irascible and fearlessly blunt Barney Panofsky.
Back in middle school after summer vacation, Greg Heffley and his older brother Rodrick must deal with their parents' misguided attempts to have them bond.
A single mother's life is thrown into turmoil after her struggling, rarely-seen younger brother returns to town.
A hard-living Hollywood actor re-examines his life after his 11-year-old daughter surprises him with a visit.
